label: H.R. 4449
title: Advocating for Small Business Act

latest_action.text: Placed on the Union Calendar, Calendar No. 207.

summary: Advocating for Small Business Act This bill requires the Securities and Exchange Commission to establish within each of its rule-issuing divisions an Office of Small Business, which must coordinate with its Office of the Advocate for Small Business Capital Formation on rules and policy priorities related to capital formation.
summary_short: Requires the Securities and Exchange Commission to establish within each of its rule-issuing divisions an Office of Small Business, which must coordinate with its Office of the Advocate for Small Business Capital Formation on rules and policy priorities related to capital formation.
